overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 2-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a premium wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for ultimate relaxation and health benefits, this sauna combines 6 advanced heaters, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features a sophisticated touch screen control panel with Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity, allowing you to enjoy your favorite tunes while unwinding. Ideal for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms, this sauna also includes Himalayan salt bars for enhanced air quality and a serene ambiance.
